Research in Civil and Environmental Engineering
Our focus
Research in Civil and Environmental Engineering explores some of society’s biggest challenges with the goal of making long lasting, impactful contributions to global communities.
Our researchers are developing innovative approaches to sustain our infrastructure, predict nature disasters, provide healthy waterways, model transport systems, source renewable energy and investigate mineral exploration.
Research themes
Research in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Monash is organised into 6 key areas, and each of these themes may also comprise several research focus areas.
Environment, Energy and Resources
Modelling, Simulation, Data and AI
Sensing and Automation Technologies
Smart, Safe and Sustainable Transport
Sustainable and Resilient Infrastructure
Water in a Changing Environment
